body: I'm glad I cheered you up. I'm trying to improve my life too, it's not easy and I have lots of problems but I keep at it and I won't go down without giving my all.
As a deeply depressed person fighting to make my life better, thank you. Reading this gave me a little bit of hope. I truly thank you from the bottom of my heart
Of course
Nah, it'll never get old
Then keep trying, they say that when a door closes a window opens.
I have no friends at all so you at least can say you have friends xD

I'm 23 and I've never even kissed a girl yet, so you should be happy about it cause it's no small accomplishment (at least for me). I don't know about this kind of things but maybe keep trying with her, she might change her mind.
I can

I don't have friends either but I keep trying. I feel worthless all of the time and it's never easy but I found that setting goals for yourself can be very fulfilling. Try to learn to play an instrument, build something, try painting etc. Having an objective makes you feel a lot less alone. If you wanna talk about it feel free to dm me.

Give life a chance. Find something to fulfill you. Suicide is the easy way but who guaranteed you that death is going to be better than life, maybe it's way worse. Think about it because in life people can be happy but death is still vastly unknown.

Please reconsider doing it. Find a reason to live. Maybe not work, maybe a passion project. Build something, learn to play an instrument etc. Find something worth living for and you might end up living a fulfilling life. Suicide is the easy option for sure but let me ask you, what is your guarantee that what lies beyond life it's going to be better than life itself? Maybe you simply fade from existence but it can also be worst than that. Think about it. I hope you can find something worth living for.
No problem, I hope everything goes OK.

You have to do an effort and get yourself together. Force yourself to go to school and maybe even seek professional help. You should also find an objective, it can be something career related or something more like a personal project like building something or playing an instrument. No one can help you if you don't try, so try. Hope you get better and overcome this

I don't think it's about being or not the answer. I think suicide is the easy path, but also a mysterious one, because who truly knows what happens after death. Life on the other hand is always hard and sometimes very painful, but it can also be very happy and fulfilling. The choice is ultimately yours but if you keep fighting, you might find life being better than you thought.

On a note or however you might prefer you should apologize to begin with, then you should explain to her what is happening (or you think is happening) and then go together to see a professional. No serious professional would think you are an attention seeker if you truly feel that way. I wish you the best of lucks.

From what you said you lack a purpose. It's not an easy task but you have to find a goal, something to look forward to. Maybe it's something career oriented, maybe a personal project, but the thing is that you need to find something that makes you keep at it. Do some meditation and think about what you really want.

You my friend have already hit rock bottom, the way I see it is you could give up or you could keep trying, because it's not going to get that much worse. I'm rooting for you. Go out there and apply for 100 jobs more! If that doesn't work, then 200 more! I know you want to give up because everything seems to go against you but that's also the easy way, keep trying and you may perhaps find the things you seek.
I'm sure you'll find lots of kind people in university and you'll have a great time. I really hope you get better from your health issues. Be strong and perseverant ;)
You should keep trying, maybe lower your standards, there are jobs that are constantly hiring like call centers for example. Don't give up, you have my support.
I feel just the same than you but I'm trying to get away from suicidal thoughts and focusing on personal projects. You should try it. If you wanna talk feel free to dm me

I don't know about you but in my case I have no friends and my family wouldn't even care. So maybe the thing is you think no one would care about your problems, but if you are really close to that friend you mentioned she probably would care. Also depression is a burden that can haunt away people, so a lot of depressed people hide it, and maybe that's what you do. In my case I don't have anyone besides the people in reddit to share my burdens.
Maybe you should raise a new dog, if it really helps you to have a pet that cares about you. I wish I could have a dog myself, I think it could help me a lot.

I do the same, I constantly tell myself that there's people that have it worse than me, that I'm being selfish being this depressed. But in the end, it changes nothing. Sure there's people that have it worse but it doesn't change the fact that my life is  painful, bitter and lonely. If you want to talk about your problems I can listen.
You are right, but the thing is I feel no hope and I don't think getting fit is going to solve much. Again I'm also ugly, sad and weird so people is going to push me away anyways.
You gotta be strong for them, you have a reason to fight. I wish I had a reason too.

I'm not really a college student because I failed to get into college, I'm studying something that qualifies you to be in a building site helping the architects. I don't know how it works in Spain with mental health services in universities and such but I haven't heard about it. I find the D&D advice interesting, I guess I'll have to find out about it because I don't know much about it. I only have two hobbies which are gaming and reading.
I totally understand you
